# Vermilion Routes

> Luxury Boutique Travel Agency & Expert-Guided Expeditions across mainland Ecuador and the Galapagos Islands.

Vermilion Routes provides bespoke luxury expeditions, Galapagos island hopping, private cruises, Amazon rainforest lodges, and Avenue of the Volcanoes treks.

## Core Destinations & Expeditions

- [Galapagos Islands](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#destinations): Island hopping, yacht excursions, Santa Cruz, Isabela, San Cristobal, Bartolome, Las Grietas, giant tortoises, marine wildlife.
- [Avenue of the Volcanoes](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#destinations): Cotopaxi National Park, Quilotoa Crater Lagoon, Chimborazo Summit Reserve, Banos Pailon del Diablo Waterfall.
- [Amazon Rainforest](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#destinations): Cuyabeno Wildlife Reserve, Yasuni National Park, Napo River motorized canoe expeditions, indigenous Kichwa communities.
- [Colonial Heritage & Markets](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#destinations): Quito Historic Center (UNESCO), Cuenca Colonial, Otavalo Indigenous Market, Ingapirca Inca Ruins.

## Featured Itineraries

- [Galapagos Islands 4-Day Itinerary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Santa Cruz highlands, Primicias giant tortoise ranch, Isabela full-day excursion, Tintoreras snorkeling.
- [Galapagos Islands 5-Day Itinerary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Comprehensive island hopping, Charles Darwin Research Station, Santa Fe and Bartolome excursions.
- [Ecuador: Andes and Amazon Rainforest (7 Days / 6 Nights)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Historic Quito, Cotopaxi, Quilotoa, Banos waterfalls, Amazon jungle lodge.
- [Ecuador and Galapagos Islands Master Journey (12 Days / 11 Nights)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Complete luxury overland expedition and Galapagos archipelago discovery.
